title: Kernel Routing Profiler: Synthetic Workload Spectra, Golden Snapshots, and CI Latency Sentinels
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a profiler-driven synthetic workload suite and automated golden snapshot process to tighten CI performance gates for kernel selection and prefill/decode scheduling. Goal: detect regressions introduced by kernel routing changes or attention optimizations early, with actionable diffs and signal prioritization for low/99th/99.9th percentiles.
acceptance_criteria: Create 6 synthetic workload families that exercise prefill-hot, decode-heavy, long-context, short-context high-QPS, KV-cache warm/cold, and attention-pattern variants
Instrument kernel routing profiler to emit per-request breakdowns (kernel choice, kernel duration, prefill/decode split, batching size) to the performance dashboard
Capture golden snapshots for each workload family (median/p50, p95, p99, p99.9 latency and tokens/sec) and store immutable artifacts
CI detects >5% regression in p95 or any increase in p99.9 and blocks merges with annotated diffs and suggested mitigations (e.g., fallbacks, route policy change, kernel pinning)
Automated triage links failing CI runs to the top 3 contributing kernels and a minimal repro trace
tasks: Design synthetic workload definitions and input corpora (encoder/decoder length mixes)
Extend profiler to tag requests with workload_family and kernel_decision metadata
Implement golden snapshot exporter and storage (S3 path + immutable metadata)
Add CI step that compares current run vs golden and publishes annotated failure artifact
Build dashboard panels for workload spectra and kernel heatmaps
Run a 2-week seed on staging and collect baseline snapshots
updates: 2026-02-12: Kickoff meeting with runtime and perf teams. Decided to prioritize 6 workload families covering prefill/decode, kv-cache, and attention variants.
2026-02-19: Prototype profiler extension landed in runtime branch kr-profiler-2026 (PR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/1284). Early traces show per-kernel durations but missing batching tags.
2026-02-24: Follow-up design review with PM and Design. Agreed on export schema (flat key-value time series) to keep CI comparisons deterministic.
2026-03-01: Implemented synthetic corpora generator. Seeded staging with 10k traces for each workload family.
2026-03-05: First golden snapshot run completed. Observed a flaky p99.9 in long-context family traced to attention kernel selection for seq_len > 8192.
2026-03-08: Temporary mitigation: CI will allow known regression in long-context while a fix is developed. Opened ENG-26745 to track attention kernel fallback patch.
2026-03-12: CI gate implemented for p95 and p99; p99.9 gating will be enabled after attention fallback deployed. Need ops help to provision S3 bucket for immutable snapshots.
notes: Trade-off: synthetic workloads prioritize signal isolation over realistic CRT distributions to minimize noisy variance in CI.
Performance noise mitigation: runs should be repeated 3x and median used for CI compare; larger runs for p99.9 stability.
We chose per-workload golden snapshots instead of a single multi-workload baseline to reduce change blast radius.
Potential follow-up: auto-suggest kernel pinning profiles per model variant based on golden performance.
